subject: Physics
stem: Car A moves east at 40.6 m/s while car B moves east at 12.2 m/s. What is A's velocity relative to B?
explanation: For motion along the same line in the same direction, relative velocity is the difference of the velocities.

subject: Physics
stem: Observer B moves with constant velocity 18.4 m/s relative to observer A. Which statement is required for the standard Galilean transformation between their frames?
options: The relative motion is uniform and rectilinear
The frames must rotate relative to each other
The relative speed must equal the speed of light
Both observers must be at rest
explanation: Galilean transformations connect inertial frames in uniform rectilinear relative motion.
